title: Design flaw, takes 10 minutes to attach garbage bag to unit and the lid would not shut
text: Design flaw, takes 10 minutes to attach garbage bag to unit and the lid would not shut. Love the size of this, actually made for a 13 gallon bag.  Major flaw, however, is in the design, it's nearly impossible to get the bag to attach as they instruct!  Spent 10 minutes fighting with it, and then just left it halfway in the can and put something on the top to make the lid stay shut.  Absolutely useless as a kitchen trash can, it will now live in the garage without the lid for excess recycle items.  Total waste of money.
